facts.text: John has a painting in his room that serves as a reminder to stay true and be a leader.

evidence.quote: I have a painting in my room to remind me to stay true and be a leader in everything I do.

facts.text: John attributes Aragorn's bravery, selflessness, and down-to-earth attitude as the qualities that make him inspiring.

evidence.quote: Aragorn's brave, selfless, down-to-earth attitude is what inspired me.

facts.text: John believes that Aragorn's commitment to justice and not giving up is a key part of his inspiring nature.

evidence.quote: He never gives up and always stands up for justice.

facts.text: John considers Aragorn's leadership and prioritizing others as reasons for his eventual ascension to kingship.

evidence.quote: He's a great leader and puts others first - that's why he eventually becomes king.
